messages:
jia: Quick note  onboarding llama5 via bridge-x into ptq-int4. Repro shows a consistent summarization/QA quality regression vs fp32. Repro steps: 
```
python tools/bridgex_convert.py --src llama5 --out ./llama5-bx/ --quant ptq-int4 --group 128
./eval/harness --model ./llama5-bx/ --task news-sum --seed 11 --batch 8
```

jia: Observed: Rouge-L -4.6, BLEU -1.9, short factual hallucinations ~10% (was ~2%), ppl +0.5. Inference stable (no crashes).

oliver: Suspects: rotary inv_freq scaling, head-dim reorder, or vocab id offset. Any quick dumps?

sam: (ping) run a per-head inv_freq compare and a logit-ddiff for first 128 tokens. That usually separates rotary vs quant-granularity issues.

jia: Launched: `./tools/logit_ddiff --ref ./models/llama5-fp32 --alt ./llama5-bx/ --len 128 --out /tmp/bx_dd.json` and dumped inv_freq per head for layer 4.

ci-bot: Job queued: 9876543210-bridgex-quant-audit.

ci-bot: Job finished. Summary: divergence starts ~token 14; top-5 mismatch climbs from 2% -> 19% by token 44. Per-head inv_freq scale deviates on heads 2 and 9 (measured ~1.0006). Group-size ablation (64/128/256) had minor effect.

natalie: Tiny per-head scale errors often amplify autoregressively. Try a local shim that multiplies those heads' inv_freq by 0.9994 (inverse) in the converted weights and re-run the smoke eval.

jia: Applied hotpatch to converted weights (inv_freq *= 0.9994 for heads 2,9) and re-ran smoke: Rouge-L gap down to ~1.0, hallucination rate ~3.7%. Logit-ddiff shows much smaller drift.

sam: Good signal. Action items: 1) add a rotary-scale sanity check in bridge-x converter (compute per-head ratio to fp32 or catalog baseline and warn if >5e-4), 2) add an auto-correct shim option that rescales inv_freq when small systematic drift detected, 3) add a 10-sample news-sum smoke eval to CI for all new converts.

jia: Filing ticket MLD-3580: "bridge-x/llama5 int4 onboarding: per-head rotary inv_freq mismatch -> quality regression" and attaching ddiff + eval artifacts.

oliver: For long-term: consider storing per-model rotary-normalizer metadata in the model catalog (explicit head multipliers) rather than heuristics. Also add a head-order parity check to catch silent reorder issues.

sam: I'll prepare the PR to add checks + smoke CI and a converter flag `--auto-fix-rotary` that can be toggled. ETA EOD tomorrow.

natalie: Thanks team. If any other converts show similar tiny-scale patterns, we should run a sweep across recently onboarded models. Ping #eng-ml with updates. :thumbsup: 

ci-bot: Closing job 9876543210-bridgex-quant-audit (artifacts: /ci/artifacts/9876543210/).
